app.agents.bridge.not_available.plugin_v.defaultMessage: Failed to parse AI plugin version.
app.agents.bridge.not_available.plugin_v.description: Error message shown when the installed AI plugin's version string could not be parsed.

app.agents.bridge.not_available.plugin_v.defaultMessage: Mattermost Agents plugin version is too old. Please update to the latest version.
app.agents.bridge.not_available.plugin_v.description: Error message shown when the installed Mattermost Agents plugin version is below the required minimum; asks the user to update it.

app.agents.bridge.unavailable_reason.description: Generic fallback error shown when the Mattermost Agents plugin cannot be used and no more specific reason applies.

app.channel.post_update_channel_purpose_.description: System message posted when the channel purpose is removed; {username} is who removed it and {old} is the previous purpose text.
System message posted when the channel purpose is removed; {username} is who removed it and {old} is the previous purpose text. This is the wording used when the channel is a board.

app.channel.post_update_channel_purpose_.defaultMessage: {username} updated the channel purpose from: {old} to: {new}
app.channel.post_update_channel_purpose_.description: System message posted when the channel purpose changes; {username} is who changed it, {old} and {new} are the previous and new purpose texts.

app.channel.post_update_channel_purpose_.defaultMessage: {username} updated the board purpose from: {old} to: {new}
app.channel.post_update_channel_purpose_.description: System message posted when the channel purpose changes; {username} is who changed it, {old} and {new} are the previous and new purpose texts. This is the wording used when the channel is a board.
System message posted when a channel purpose is set for the first time; {username} is who set it and {new} is the new purpose text.
System message posted when a channel purpose is set for the first time; {username} is who set it and {new} is the new purpose text. This is the wording used when the channel is a board.

app.post.move_thread_command.channel.mul.defaultMessage: A thread with {numMessages, number} messages has been moved: {link}
app.post.move_thread_command.channel.mul.description: System message left in the source channel after a thread is moved away; {numMessages} is the number of messages moved and {link} is a permalink to the thread's new location.

app.post.move_thread_command.channel.one.description: System message left in the source channel after a single message is moved away; {link} is a permalink to its new location.

app.post.move_thread_command.direct_or_g.defaultMessage: A thread with {numMessages, number} messages has been moved to a Direct/Group Message
app.post.move_thread_command.direct_or_g.description: System message left in the source channel when a thread is moved into a direct or group message; {numMessages} is the number of messages moved.

app.post.move_thread_command.direct_or_g.defaultMessage: A message has been moved to a Direct/Group Message
app.post.move_thread_command.direct_or_g.description: System message left in the source channel when a single message is moved into a direct or group message.

app.post.move_thread.from_another_channe.defaultMessage: This thread was moved from another channel
app.post.move_thread.from_another_channe.description: System message shown on a thread that was moved into the current channel from elsewhere.

apps_form_file_upload.hydration_failed.description: Error text on a file upload field in an apps form when a previously attached file could not be loaded.

apps_form_file_upload.max_files.defaultMessage: Uploads limited to {count, number} files maximum.
apps_form_file_upload.max_files.description: Error text on a file upload field in an apps form when the user selects more files than allowed; {count} is the maximum number of files.

apps_form_file_upload.upload_failed.description: Generic error shown on a file in an apps form upload field when its upload fails.

apps_form.date_field.placeholder.description: Placeholder of a date picker field in an apps form / interactive dialog.

apps_form.datetime_field.timezone_hint.description: Hint below a date-time field in an apps form telling the user which timezone applies; {timezone} is the timezone name.

apps.error.description: Generic error wrapper for responses from the Apps framework (interactive integrations); {error} is the error detail text returned by the app or server.

apps.error.command.field_missing.description: Error shown when executing an App slash command with required fields left blank; {fieldName} is the field's name; backticks render as code formatting.

apps.error.command.same_channel.description: Error shown when the same channel is given twice for a multi-value App slash command field; {fieldName} is the field name and {option} the repeated value; backticks render as code.

apps.error.command.same_option.description: Error shown when the same option is given twice for a multi-value App slash command field; {fieldName} is the field name and {option} the repeated value; backticks render as code.

apps.error.command.same_user.description: Error shown when the same user is given twice for a multi-value App slash command field; {fieldName} is the field name and {option} the repeated value; backticks render as code.

apps.error.command.unknown_channel.description: Error shown when an App slash command field references a channel that does not exist; {fieldName} is the field name and {option} the entered value; backticks render as code.

apps.error.command.unknown_option.description: Error shown when an App slash command field is given a value not in its allowed options; {fieldName} is the field name and {option} the entered value; backticks render as code.

apps.error.command.unknown_user.description: Error shown when an App slash command field references a user that does not exist; {fieldName} is the field name and {option} the entered value; backticks render as code.

apps.error.form.no_form.description: Error shown when an App's response is missing its form definition; `form` is an API field name (do not translate); shown to users but aimed at app developers.

apps.error.form.no_lookup.description: Error shown when an App form field needs dynamic lookup but no lookup call is defined; `lookup` is an API field name (do not translate).

apps.error.form.no_source.description: Error shown when an App form is missing its source call; `source` is an API field name (do not translate).

apps.error.form.no_submit.description: Error shown when an App form is missing its submit call; `submit` is an API field name (do not translate).

apps.error.form.refresh.defaultMessage: There has been an error updating the modal. Contact the app developer. Details: {details}
apps.error.form.refresh.description: Error shown in an App modal when refreshing the form fails; {details} is the error detail from the app; audience includes app developers.

apps.error.form.refresh_no_refresh.defaultMessage: Called refresh on no refresh field.
apps.error.form.refresh_no_refresh.description: Internal error shown when an App form field triggers a refresh but is not marked as refreshable; aimed at app developers.

apps.error.form.required_fields_empty.description: Validation error shown at the bottom of an App form modal when one or more fields have errors.

apps.error.form.submit.pretext.defaultMessage: There has been an error submitting the modal. Contact the app developer. Details: {details}
apps.error.form.submit.pretext.description: Error shown when submitting an App modal fails; {details} is the error detail from the app; audience includes app developers.

apps.error.form.update.defaultMessage: There has been an error updating the modal. Contact the app developer. Details: {details}
apps.error.form.update.description: Error shown when updating an App modal fails; {details} is the error detail from the app; audience includes app developers.

apps.error.lookup.error_preparing_reques.description: Error shown when building a dynamic-lookup request for an App form field fails; {errorMessage} is the underlying error text.

apps.error.malformed_binding.defaultMessage: This binding is not properly formed. Contact the App developer.
apps.error.malformed_binding.description: Error shown when an App's UI binding definition is invalid; 'binding' is an Apps framework term and 'App' means an installed Mattermost App.

apps.error.parser.description: Generic parsing error prefix for App slash command input; {error} is the specific parser error message.

apps.error.parser.empty_value.description: App slash command parser error shown when a field value is empty.

apps.error.parser.execute_non_leaf.description: App slash command error shown when the user runs a command that has subcommands without choosing one; 'subcommand' is a nested command.

apps.error.parser.missing_binding.description: App slash command error shown when the command's binding definitions cannot be found; 'binding' is an Apps framework term.

apps.error.parser.missing_field_value.description: App slash command parser error shown when a flag or field is given without a value.

apps.error.parser.missing_list_end.description: App slash command parser error shown when a list value is not closed with its closing bracket; 'token' is a parser symbol.

apps.error.parser.missing_quote.defaultMessage: Matching double quote expected before end of input.
apps.error.parser.missing_quote.description: App slash command parser error shown when a double-quoted value is not closed before the input ends.

apps.error.parser.missing_source.defaultMessage: Form has neither submit nor source.
apps.error.parser.missing_source.description: App form validation error shown when a form defines neither a submit call nor a source; 'submit' and 'source' are API field names.

apps.error.parser.missing_submit.defaultMessage: No submit call in binding or form.
apps.error.parser.missing_submit.description: App slash command error shown when neither the binding nor its form defines a submit call; 'binding', 'form' and 'submit' are Apps framework terms.

apps.error.parser.missing_tick.defaultMessage: Matching tick quote expected before end of input.
apps.error.parser.missing_tick.description: App slash command parser error shown when a backtick-quoted value is not closed before the input ends; 'tick quote' is the ` character.

apps.error.parser.multiple_equal.description: App slash command parser error shown when a flag assignment contains more than one = sign; backticks render as code.

apps.error.parser.no_argument_pos_x.description: App slash command parser error shown when a token in the input cannot be matched to any command argument.

apps.error.parser.no_bindings.description: App slash command error shown when no command bindings are available on the server; 'binding' is an Apps framework term.

apps.error.parser.no_form.description: App slash command error shown when the matched command has no form definition to collect its arguments.

apps.error.parser.no_match.defaultMessage: `{command}`: No matching command found in this workspace.
apps.error.parser.no_match.description: Error shown when the typed slash command matches no installed App command; {command} is the text the user typed; backticks render as code; 'workspace' is the Mattermost server.

apps.error.parser.no_slash_start.description: App slash command parser error shown when the input does not begin with the / character; backticks render as code.

apps.error.parser.unexpected_character.description: App slash command parser error shown when an invalid character is encountered in the input.

apps.error.parser.unexpected_comma.description: App slash command parser error shown when a comma appears in an invalid position.

apps.error.parser.unexpected_error.description: Fallback App slash command parser error for unclassified failures.

apps.error.parser.unexpected_flag.description: App slash command parser error shown when the user supplies a flag the command does not define; {flagName} is the flag's name; backticks render as code.

apps.error.parser.unexpected_squared_bra.description: App slash command parser error shown when a list opening bracket appears where a list is not allowed.

apps.error.parser.unexpected_state.description: Internal 'should never happen' App slash command parser error; {state} is the internal parser state name; aimed at developers.

apps.error.parser.unexpected_whitespace.description: Internal 'should never happen' App slash command parser error about whitespace handling; aimed at developers.

apps.error.responses.form.no_form.defaultMessage: Response type is `form`, but no form was included in response.
apps.error.responses.form.no_form.description: Error shown when an App responds with type 'form' but includes no form data; `form` is an API value (do not translate); aimed at app developers.

apps.error.responses.navigate.no_url.defaultMessage: Response type is `navigate`, but no url was included in response.
apps.error.responses.navigate.no_url.description: Error shown when an App responds with type 'navigate' but includes no URL; `navigate` is an API value (do not translate); aimed at app developers.

apps.error.responses.unexpected_error.description: Generic error shown when an App call returns an unexpected error with no details.

apps.error.responses.unexpected_type.defaultMessage: App response type was not expected. Response type: {type}
apps.error.responses.unexpected_type.description: Error shown when an App returns a response type that is not valid in the current context; {type} is the response type identifier.

apps.error.responses.unknown_field_error.defaultMessage:
Received an error for an unknown field. Field name: `{field}`. Error:
{error}
apps.error.responses.unknown_field_error.description: Error shown when an App returns a field error for a field that does not exist in the form; {field} is the field name and {error} the error text; contains a newline.

apps.error.responses.unknown_type.defaultMessage: App response type not supported. Response type: {type}.
apps.error.responses.unknown_type.description: Error shown when an App returns a response type the client does not support; {type} is the response type identifier.

apps.error.unknown.description: Generic fallback error message for App (Apps framework) failures with no further detail.

apps.suggestion.dynamic.error.description: Hint row in the slash command autocomplete when fetching dynamic options from an app failed; followed by the error detail.

apps.suggestion.errors.parser_error.description: Hint row in the slash command autocomplete when the typed command could not be parsed; followed by the error detail.

apps.suggestion.no_dynamic.defaultMessage: No data was returned for dynamic suggestions
apps.suggestion.no_dynamic.description: Description row in the slash command autocomplete when an app returned no dynamic suggestion data.

apps.suggestion.no_static.description: Hint row in the slash command autocomplete when no predefined options match the typed text.

apps.suggestion.no_suggestion.description: Hint row in the slash command autocomplete when nothing matches the typed command.

attachment.footerIconAltText.description: Alt text for the small footer icon image of a message attachment rendered by the interactive-message block renderer.

attachment.imageAltText.description: Alt text for the thumbnail image of a message attachment rendered by the interactive-message block renderer.

audit_table.accountActive.description: Audit log entry in the access history table: the account was activated.

audit_table.accountInactive.description: Audit log entry in the access history table: the account was deactivated.

audit_table.action.description: Column header of the access history (audit log) table; the column describes what action was performed.

audit_table.attemptedAllowOAuthAccess.defaultMessage: Attempted to allow a new OAuth service access
audit_table.attemptedAllowOAuthAccess.description: Audit log entry: the user attempted to authorize a new OAuth service.

audit_table.attemptedLicenseAdd.description: Audit log entry: an attempt was made to upload a new license to the server.

audit_table.attemptedLogin.description: Audit log entry: a login attempt was made on the account.

audit_table.attemptedOAuthToken.defaultMessage: Attempted to get an OAuth access token
audit_table.attemptedOAuthToken.description: Audit log entry: an attempt was made to obtain an OAuth access token.

audit_table.attemptedPassword.description: Audit log entry: an attempt was made to change the account password.

audit_table.attemptedRegisterApp.defaultMessage: Attempted to register a new OAuth Application with ID {id}
audit_table.attemptedRegisterApp.description: Audit log entry: an attempt was made to register a new OAuth application; {id} is the application's ID.

audit_table.attemptedReset.description: Audit log entry: an attempt was made to reset the account password.

audit_table.attemptedWebhookCreate.description: Audit log entry: an attempt was made to create a webhook integration.

audit_table.attemptedWebhookDelete.description: Audit log entry: an attempt was made to delete a webhook integration.

audit_table.authenticated.description: Audit log entry: the user's credentials were successfully verified.

audit_table.by.description: Suffix concatenated onto session-related audit log entries naming who performed the action; {username} is that user's username. The leading space must be preserved.

audit_table.byAdmin.description: Fragment appended (note the leading space) to an action description in the user's access history / audit table, indicating an admin performed the action rather than the user.

audit_table.channelCreated.description: Audit log entry: the user created a channel; {channelName} is the channel's name.

audit_table.channelDeleted.defaultMessage: Archived the channel with the URL {url}
audit_table.channelDeleted.description: Audit log entry: a channel was archived; {url} is the channel's URL.

audit_table.establishedDM.defaultMessage: Established a direct message channel with {username}
audit_table.establishedDM.description: Audit log entry: a direct message channel was started with another user; {username} is that user's username.

audit_table.failedExpiredLicenseAdd.defaultMessage: Failed to add a new license as it has either expired or not yet been started
audit_table.failedExpiredLicenseAdd.description: Audit log entry: uploading a license failed because it was expired or not yet valid.

audit_table.failedInvalidLicenseAdd.defaultMessage: Failed to add an invalid license
audit_table.failedInvalidLicenseAdd.description: Audit log entry: uploading a license failed because the license was invalid.

audit_table.failedLogin.description: Audit log entry for a failed login attempt; 'FAILED' is intentionally emphasized in caps.

audit_table.failedOAuthAccess.defaultMessage: Failed to allow a new OAuth service access - the redirect URI did not match the previously registered callback
audit_table.failedOAuthAccess.description: Audit log entry: authorizing an OAuth service failed because the redirect URI did not match the registered callback.

audit_table.failedPassword.defaultMessage: Failed to change password - tried to update user password who was logged in through OAuth
audit_table.failedPassword.description: Audit log entry: a password change failed because the account authenticates through OAuth.

audit_table.failedWebhookCreate.defaultMessage: Failed to create a webhook - bad channel permissions
audit_table.failedWebhookCreate.description: Audit log entry: creating a webhook failed due to insufficient channel permissions.

audit_table.failedWebhookDelete.defaultMessage: Failed to delete a webhook - inappropriate conditions
audit_table.failedWebhookDelete.description: Audit log entry: deleting a webhook failed due to invalid conditions.

audit_table.headerUpdated.description: Audit log entry: the user updated a channel's header text; {channelName} is the channel's name.

audit_table.ip.description: Column header of the access history (audit log) table for the IP address of the request.

audit_table.licenseRemoved.description: Audit log entry: a license was removed from the server.

audit_table.loginAttempt.description: Parenthetical suffix concatenated onto session audit entries marking them as a login attempt; the leading space must be preserved.

audit_table.loginFailure.description: Parenthetical suffix concatenated onto session audit entries marking them as a failed login; the leading space must be preserved.

audit_table.logout.description: Audit log entry: the user logged out of their account.

audit_table.member.description: Lowercase role name appended after the 'Updated user role(s) to ' audit entry when the user was set to a plain member; concatenated mid-sentence.

audit_table.nameUpdated.description: Audit log entry: the user renamed a channel; {channelName} is the channel's name.

audit_table.oauthTokenFailed.defaultMessage: Failed to get an OAuth access token - {token}
audit_table.oauthTokenFailed.description: Audit log entry: obtaining an OAuth access token failed; {token} holds the failure description.

audit_table.revokedAll.defaultMessage: Revoked all current sessions for the team
audit_table.revokedAll.description: Audit log entry: all active sessions for the team were revoked.

audit_table.sentEmail.defaultMessage: Sent an email to {email} to reset your password
audit_table.sentEmail.description: Audit log entry: a password reset email was sent; {email} is the destination email address.

audit_table.session.description: Column header of the access history (audit log) table for the session identifier.

audit_table.sessionRevoked.defaultMessage: The session with id {sessionId} was revoked
audit_table.sessionRevoked.description: Row description in the access history / audit table; {sessionId} is the identifier of the login session that was revoked.

audit_table.successfulLicenseAdd.description: Audit log entry: a new license was uploaded successfully.

audit_table.successfulLogin.description: Audit log entry: the user logged in successfully.

audit_table.successfulOAuthAccess.defaultMessage: Successfully gave a new OAuth service access
audit_table.successfulOAuthAccess.description: Audit log entry: a new OAuth service was authorized successfully.

audit_table.successfulOAuthToken.defaultMessage: Successfully added a new OAuth service
audit_table.successfulOAuthToken.description: Audit log entry: a new OAuth service was added successfully.

audit_table.successfulPassword.description: Row description in the user's Access History audit table (Profile > Security), describing a past account action.

audit_table.successfulReset.description: Row description in the user's Access History audit table, describing a past password reset action.

audit_table.successfulWebhookCreate.description: Row description in the user's Access History audit table, describing a webhook creation event.

audit_table.successfulWebhookDelete.description: Row description in the user's Access History audit table, describing a webhook deletion event.

audit_table.timestamp.description: Column header of the access history (audit log) table for when the action happened.

audit_table.updatedRol.description: Row description in the user's Access History audit table; ends with a space because the role name(s) are appended directly after this text.

audit_table.updateGeneral.defaultMessage: Updated the general settings of your account
audit_table.updateGeneral.description: Row description in the user's Access History audit table; 'your account' refers to the viewing user's own account.

audit_table.updateGlobalNotifications.description: Row description in the user's Access History audit table, describing a change to the user's own notification settings.

audit_table.updatePicture.description: Row description in the user's Access History audit table, describing a profile picture change.

audit_table.userAdded.description: Row description in the user's Access History audit table; {username} is the added user's name and {channelName} is the channel name.

audit_table.userId.description: Column header of the access history (audit log) table for the ID of the acting user.

audit_table.userRemoved.description: Row description in the user's Access History audit table; {username} is the removed user's name and {channelName} is the channel name.

audit_table.verified.description: Row description in the user's Access History audit table, describing successful email address verification.

authorize.allow.description: Primary button on the OAuth authorization page; grants the external app access to the user's account.

authorize.allowAccess.description: Heading on the OAuth authorization page asking the user to grant an application access; {appName} is the application's name, <b> renders it bold.

authorize.connectTitle.defaultMessage: Authorize {appName} to Connect to Your Mattermost User Account
authorize.connectTitle.description: Heading of the OAuth authorization page shown when an external app requests account access; {appName} is the OAuth app's name, <b> renders bold text.

authorize.deny.description: Button on the OAuth authorization page; rejects the external app's access request.

authorize.modificationAccess.defaultMessage: The app {appName} would like the ability to access and modify your basic information.
authorize.modificationAccess.description: Explanatory paragraph on the OAuth authorization page; {appName} is the OAuth app's name, <b> renders bold text.

avatar.alt.description: Alt text for a user's profile picture; {username} is that user's username.

avatars.overflowUnnamedOnly.description: Tooltip/label for the '+N' overflow indicator on a stack of user avatars when no names are listed; {overflowUnnamedCount} is the number of additional people.

avatars.overflowUsers.defaultMessage: {overflowUnnamedCount, plural, =0 {{names}} =1 {{names} and one other} other {{names} and # others}}
avatars.overflowUsers.description: Tooltip for the overflow indicator on a stack of user avatars; {names} is a list of usernames and {overflowUnnamedCount} the count of further unnamed people.

backstage_list.paginatorCount.description: Pagination range indicator in the footer of backstage lists; {startCount} and {endCount} are the first/last visible item numbers, {total} is the total item count.

backstage_list.search.description: Default placeholder for the search input at the top of backstage lists (integrations, custom emoji).

backstage_navbar.back.description: Label of the back link in the backstage (integrations/emoji) top navigation bar, shown when the team no longer exists.

backstage_navbar.backToMattermost.description: Back-navigation link in the integrations/emoji backstage top bar; {siteName} is the configured site name (e.g. 'Mattermost').

backstage_sidebar.bots.description: Category link in the backstage sidebar; opens the Bot Accounts management page.

backstage_sidebar.emoji.description: Category link in the backstage sidebar; opens the Custom Emoji management page.

backstage_sidebar.integrations.description: Category link in the backstage sidebar; opens the Integrations section (webhooks, slash commands, etc.).

backstage_sidebar.integrations.commands.description: Sidebar navigation item in the integrations backstage for slash commands (commands typed with a leading /).

backstage_sidebar.integrations.incoming_.description: Sidebar navigation item in the integrations backstage for incoming webhooks (a Mattermost integration type).

backstage_sidebar.integrations.oauthApps.description: Sidebar navigation item in the integrations backstage for OAuth 2.0 applications; keep 'OAuth 2.0' as-is.

backstage_sidebar.integrations.outgoing_.description: Sidebar navigation item in the integrations backstage for outgoing webhooks (a Mattermost integration type).

backstage_sidebar.integrations.outgoingO.description: Sidebar navigation item in the integrations backstage for outgoing OAuth 2.0 connections; keep 'OAuth 2.0' as-is.

billing.subscription.info.mostRecentPaym.description: Title of a danger banner on the cloud Subscription page when the latest payment attempt failed.

billing.subscription.info.mostRecentPaym.defaultMessage: It looks like your most recent payment failed because the credit card on your account has expired. Please <link>update your payment information</link> to avoid any disruption.
billing.subscription.info.mostRecentPaym.description: Warning text on the Cloud billing/subscription admin page when the last payment failed due to an expired card; <link> wraps the clickable 'update your payment information' text.

bot.add.default_token.expiry.description: Label for the expiry picker in the 'Default access token' section of the Add Bot Account page (Integrations > Bot Accounts). It sets when the bot's first token expires. 'Expires' is a verb.

bot.add.default_token.title.description: Bold section heading on the Add Bot Account page (Integrations > Bot Accounts) for the access token created automatically with a new bot.

bot.add.description.description: Form field label on the bot create/edit form; free-text description of what the bot does.

bot.add.description.help.defaultMessage: (Optional) Let others know what this bot does.
bot.add.description.help.description: Help text under the description field on the Add/Edit Bot Account page in the integrations backstage; the bot is an automated account.

bot.add.display_name.help.defaultMessage: (Optional) You can choose to display your bot's full name rather than its username.
bot.add.display_name.help.description: Help text under the Display Name field on the bot create/edit form.

bot.add.post_all.description: Checkbox label on the bot create/edit form; 'post:all' is a literal permission name and should not be translated.

bot.add.post_all.enabled.description: Checkbox option label ('Enabled') for the post:all permission on the Add/Edit Bot Account page; compact space.

bot.add.post_all.help.defaultMessage: Bot will have access to post to all Mattermost channels including direct messages.
bot.add.post_all.help.description: Help text for the post:all permission checkbox on the Add/Edit Bot Account page, explaining the bot can post to any channel including direct messages.

bot.add.post_channels.description: Checkbox label on the bot create/edit form; 'post:channels' is a literal permission name and should not be translated.

bot.add.post_channels.enabled.description: Checkbox option label ('Enabled') for the post:channels permission on the Add/Edit Bot Account page; compact space.

bot.add.post_channels.help.defaultMessage: Bot will have access to post to all Mattermost public channels.
bot.add.post_channels.help.description: Help text for the post:channels permission checkbox on the Add/Edit Bot Account page, explaining the bot can post to public channels.

bot.add.role.description: Form field label on the bot create/edit form for the dropdown choosing the bot's system role (Member or System Admin).

bot.add.role.admin.description: Option in the role dropdown on the Add/Edit Bot Account page granting the bot the System Admin role.

bot.add.role.help.defaultMessage: Choose what role the bot should have.
bot.add.role.help.description: Help text under the role dropdown on the Add/Edit Bot Account page.

bot.add.role.member.description: Option in the role dropdown on the Add/Edit Bot Account page granting the bot the regular Member role.

bot.add.username.help.defaultMessage: You can use lowercase letters, numbers, periods, dashes, and underscores.
bot.add.username.help.description: Help text under the Username field on the bot create/edit form describing allowed username characters.

bot.create_failed.description: Error message shown on the bot create form when the server fails to create the bot.

bot.create_token.close.description: Button that dismisses the panel showing a newly created bot access token.

bot.edit_failed.description: Error message shown on the bot edit form when the server fails to save changes to the bot.

bot.manage.create_token.description: Link label (verb phrase) on a bot account row; opens the form to create a new access token for the bot.

bot.manage.disable.description: Link label (verb) on a bot account row; deactivates the bot.

bot.manage.enable.description: Link label (verb) on a disabled bot account row; reactivates the bot.

Once selected, the username will automatically replace the full name or nickname. The following example sends a special mention notification to alice that alerts her of the channel and message where she has been mentioned. If alice is away from Mattermost and has email notifications turned on, then she will receive an email alert of her mention along with the message text.

message_submit_error.invalidCommand.defaultMessage: Command with a trigger of ''{command}'' not found.

mfa.confirm.complete.description: Heading on the final confirmation screen after multi-factor authentication setup succeeds.

mfa.confirm.okay.description: Button label on the MFA setup confirmation screen that dismisses it and continues into the app.

mfa.confirm.secure.defaultMessage: Your account is now secure. Next time you sign in, you will be asked to enter a code from your authenticator app on your phone.
mfa.confirm.secure.description: Body text on the MFA setup confirmation screen explaining that a code from the authenticator app will be required on future sign-ins.

mfa.setup.badCode.defaultMessage: Invalid code. If this issue persists, contact your System Administrator.
mfa.setup.badCode.description: Error message on the MFA setup page when the entered authenticator code is not valid.

mfa.setup.code.description: Placeholder of the input field on the MFA setup page where the user enters the code from their authenticator app.

mfa.setup.codeError.defaultMessage: Please enter the code from your authenticator app.
mfa.setup.codeError.description: Validation error during multi-factor authentication setup when the code from the authenticator app is missing or empty.

mfa.setup.required_mfa.description: Notice at the top of the MFA setup page when the admin requires MFA; {siteName} is the server or site name, and <strong> marks bold text.

mfa.setup.save.description: Submit button label on the MFA setup page that verifies the entered code and enables MFA.

mfa.setup.secret.description: Line on the MFA setup page displaying the manual-entry secret key; {secret} is the generated secret string.

mfa.setup.step2_secret.defaultMessage: Alternatively, enter the secret key displayed below into the authenticator app manually.
mfa.setup.step2_secret.description: Alternative instruction on the MFA setup page for entering the secret key manually instead of scanning the QR code.

mfa.setup.step3_code.defaultMessage: 2. Enter the code generated by the authenticator app in the field below.
mfa.setup.step3_code.description: Second numbered instruction on the MFA setup page telling the user to enter the code generated by their authenticator app.

mfa.setupTitle.description: Page heading for the multi-factor authentication setup flow shown after login when MFA is required.

modal.manual_status.auto_responder.messa.description: Body of the prompt asking the user to leave Out-of-Office; switching to "Online" also disables their automatic reply message.

modal.manual_status.button_dnd.description: Confirm button of the status-reset prompt; sets the user's availability to the "Do not disturb" status.

modal.manual_status.button_offline.description: Confirm button of the status-reset prompt; sets the user's availability to the "Offline" status.

modal.manual_status.button_online.description: Confirm button of the status-reset prompt; sets the user's availability to the "Online" status.

modal.manual_status.cancel_away.description: Cancel button of the status-reset prompt; keeps the user's manually set "Away" status.

modal.manual_status.cancel_dnd.description: Cancel button of the status-reset prompt; keeps the user's manually set "Do not disturb" status.

modal.manual_status.message_dnd.defaultMessage: Would you like to switch your status to "Do not disturb"?

modal.manual_status.message_offline.defaultMessage: Would you like to switch your status to "Offline"?
modal.manual_status.message_offline.description: Body of the dialog asking whether to change the user's availability; "Offline" is a status name.

modal.manual_status.message_online.defaultMessage: Would you like to switch your status to "Online"?
modal.manual_status.message_online.description: Body of the dialog asking whether to change the user's availability back after a manual status; "Online" is a status name.

modal.manual_status.title_away.description: Title of the dialog prompting the user to reset their manually set "Away" status.

modal.manual_status.title_dnd.defaultMessage: Your status is set to "Do not disturb"
modal.manual_status.title_dnd.description: Title of the dialog prompting the user to reset their manually set "Do not disturb" status.

modal.manual_status.title_offline.description: Title of the dialog prompting the user to reset their manually set "Offline" status.

modal.manual_status.title_ooo.defaultMessage: Your status is set to "Out of office"
modal.manual_status.title_ooo.description: Title of the dialog prompting the user to reset their "Out of office" status.

more_channels.channel_purpose.defaultMessage: Channel Information: Membership Indicator: Joined, Member count {memberCount}, Purpose: {channelPurpose}
more_channels.channel_purpose.description: Screen-reader description of a channel row in the Browse Channels modal; {memberCount} is the number of members and {channelPurpose} is the channel's purpose text.

more_channels.channel_purpose.board.description: Screen-reader description of a channel row in the Browse Channels modal; {memberCount} is the number of members and {channelPurpose} is the channel's purpose text. This is the wording used when the channel is a board.

more_channels.channel_type_filter.description: Accessibility label for the channel-type filter dropdown in the Browse Channels modal.

more_channels.channel_type_filter.filter.description: Screen-reader-only announcement in the Browse Channels dialog when the channel type filter changes; {filterType} is the selected filter's name.

more_channels.count.description: Compact result-count label above a paginated channel list; {count} is the number of matching channels (always more than one; separate strings exist for 0 and 1).

more_channels.count_one.description: Result count label in the Browse Channels dialog when exactly one channel matches; compact.

more_channels.count_zero.description: Result count label in the Browse Channels dialog when no channels match; compact.

more_channels.create.description: Button label (and aria-label) in the Browse Channels modal; opens the create-channel flow. Also shown in the empty search results state.

more_channels.discoverable.description: Label in the Browse Channels modal identifying discoverable private channels; adjective describing channels.

more_channels.discoverable.aria.description: Accessibility label for the indicator on a private channel in Browse Channels that is discoverable (users can request to join).

more_channels.discoverable.aria.board.description: Accessibility label for the indicator on a private channel in Browse Channels that is discoverable (users can request to join). This is the wording used when the channel is a board.

more_channels.hide_archived.description: Visible text of the checkbox in the Browse Channels dialog that hides archived channels from the results list. Verb phrase; "Archived" here modifies channels.

more_channels.hide_archived_channels.description: Screen-reader label for that same "Hide Archived" checkbox in the Browse Channels dialog; the fuller wording exists only for accessibility.

more_channels.hide_joined.description: Checkbox label in the Browse Channels modal that hides channels the user has already joined.

more_channels.hide_joined_channels.description: Checkbox label in the Browse Channels dialog that hides channels the user has already joined.

more_channels.joined.description: Badge on a channel row in the Browse Channels modal indicating the user is already a member; compact space.

more_channels.joinedChannel.board.description: Screen-reader-only announcement after the user successfully joins a channel from Browse Channels; {channelName} is the channel's name. This is the wording used when the channel is a board.

more_channels.membership_indicator.description: Screen-reader text on a channel row in the Browse Channels modal indicating the user has joined that channel.

more_channels.next.description: Pagination button under a channel or team list that goes to the next page of results.

more_channels.noArchived.description: Empty-state text in the Browse Channels modal when there are no archived channels to show.

more_channels.noChannels.description: Empty-state text in the Browse Channels modal when no channels are available.

more_channels.noDiscoverable.description: Empty-state text in the Browse Channels modal when there are no discoverable private channels.

more_channels.noMore.description: Empty-state headline in a searchable channel or team list; {text} is the user's search text.

more_channels.prev.description: Pagination button under a channel or team list that goes to the previous page of results.

more_channels.requesting.description: In-progress label of the request-to-join button in the Browse Channels modal while the request is being sent.

more_channels.requestToJoin.description: Button on a discoverable private channel row in the Browse Channels modal that sends a join request; compact button.

more_channels.searchError.defaultMessage: Try searching different keywords, checking for typos or adjusting the filters.
more_channels.searchError.description: Secondary message shown in the Browse Channels modal when a channel search returns no results.

more_channels.show_all_channels.description: Selected-filter label in the Browse Channels modal's channel-type dropdown showing all channel types.

more_channels.show_archived_channels.description: Selected-filter label in the Browse Channels modal's channel-type dropdown for archived channels.

more_channels.show_discoverable_channels.description: Option in the Browse Channels channel-type filter for discoverable private channels.

more_channels.show_my_pending_requests.description: Option in the Browse Channels channel-type filter listing the user's own pending join requests.

more_channels.show_private_channels.description: Selected-filter label in the Browse Channels modal's channel-type dropdown for private channels.

more_channels.show_public_channels.description: Selected-filter label in the Browse Channels modal's channel-type dropdown for public channels.

more_channels.show_recommended_channels.description: Option in the Browse Channels channel-type filter for channels recommended to the user.

more_channels.title.description: Title of the Browse Channels modal, which lists channels the user can join.

more_channels.view.description: Button on a channel row in the Browse Channels modal for channels the user already belongs to; opens the channel; 'View' is a verb; compact button.

more_channels.withdraw.description: Button in the Browse Channels modal that withdraws a pending join request; verb; compact button.

more_channels.withdrawing.description: Button text while a join-request withdrawal is in progress; ellipsis indicates progress.

more_channels.withdrawRequest.description: Button label to withdraw a pending request to join a discoverable private channel; 'Withdraw' is a verb.

move_thread_modal.button.cancel.description: Cancel button label in the 'Move thread' dialog.

multiselect.list.notFound.description: Empty-state text in a multi-select list when no options match the search; {searchQuery} is the user's search text and <b> wraps it in bold.

post_attributes.modal.empty.description: Shown in the post attributes modal when the post has no attributes this user can see and there is none they are allowed to add.

post_attributes.modal.error.forbidden.defaultMessage: You do not have permission to change this attribute
post_attributes.modal.error.forbidden.description: Error shown in the post attributes modal when the server refuses to save a change to an attribute because the user lacks permission.

post_attributes.modal.error.generic.defaultMessage: Could not update this attribute. Please try again.
post_attributes.modal.error.generic.description: Error shown in the post attributes modal when saving a change to an attribute fails for any reason other than missing permission.

post_attributes.modal.locked.defaultMessage: You don't have permission to modify this attribute.
post_attributes.modal.locked.description: Tooltip on an attribute row in the post attributes modal that is read-only for the current user, explaining that they cannot change it.

post_attributes.modal.picker.label.description: Accessible label (screen readers only) of the menu, opened by the add attribute button in the post attributes modal, that lists attributes which can be added to the post.

post_attributes.modal.subtitle.description: Subtitle under the title of the post attributes modal, identifying the post. {author} is the name of the post author and {channel} is the name of the channel it was posted in; the dot between them is a separator.

post_attributes.modal.title.description: Title of the modal where users view and edit the attributes (structured metadata fields) attached to a post.

post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_group.defaultMessage: did not get notified by this mention because they are not in the channel. They cannot be added to the channel because they are not a member of the linked groups. To add them to this channel, they must be added to the linked groups.
post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_group.description: Ephemeral notice shown after mentioning group members who are not in the channel; concatenated after the list of mentioned usernames (e.g. '@user did not get notified...'); channel membership is controlled by linked LDAP groups.

post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_group.defaultMessage: did not get notified by this mention because they are not in the board. They cannot be added to the board because they are not a member of the linked groups. To add them to this board, they must be added to the linked groups.
post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_group.description: Ephemeral notice shown after mentioning group members who are not in the channel; concatenated after the list of mentioned usernames (e.g. '@user did not get notified...'); channel membership is controlled by linked LDAP groups. This is the wording used when the channel is a board.

post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.description: Conjunction joining two 'add them to the channel' links in the out-of-channel mention notice; concatenated between links, keep surrounding spaces.

post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.defaultMessage: add them to this private channel
post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.description: Clickable link text inside the out-of-channel mention notice; adds the mentioned users to the current private channel; embedded mid-sentence.

post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.defaultMessage: add them to this private board
post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.description: Clickable link text inside the out-of-channel mention notice; adds the mentioned users to the current private channel; embedded mid-sentence. This is the wording used when the channel is a board.
Clickable link text inside the out-of-channel mention notice; adds the mentioned users to the current public channel; embedded mid-sentence.
Clickable link text inside the out-of-channel mention notice; adds the mentioned users to the current public channel; embedded mid-sentence. This is the wording used when the channel is a board.

post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.defaultMessage: ? They will have access to all message history.
post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.description: Final fragment of the out-of-channel mention notice, concatenated directly after the 'add them to the channel' link to close the question sentence.

post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.defaultMessage: did not get notified by this mention because they are not in the channel. Would you like to
post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.description: Middle fragment of the ephemeral notice shown after mentioning multiple users not in the channel; preceded by the list of usernames and followed by an 'add them to the channel' link, so keep the trailing space.

post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.defaultMessage: did not get notified by this mention because they are not in the board. Would you like to
post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.description: Middle fragment of the ephemeral notice shown after mentioning multiple users not in the channel; preceded by the list of usernames and followed by an 'add them to the channel' link, so keep the trailing space. This is the wording used when the channel is a board.

post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.defaultMessage: did not get notified by this mention because they are not in the channel. Would you like to
post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.description: Middle fragment of the ephemeral notice shown after mentioning one user not in the channel; preceded by the username and followed by an 'add them to the channel' link, so keep the trailing space.

post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.defaultMessage: did not get notified by this mention because they are not in the board. Would you like to
post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.description: Middle fragment of the ephemeral notice shown after mentioning one user not in the channel; preceded by the username and followed by an 'add them to the channel' link, so keep the trailing space. This is the wording used when the channel is a board.
Link text summarizing additional mentioned users in the out-of-channel mention notice; {numOthers} is the count of extra users; clicking expands the full list.

post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.defaultMessage: did not get notified by this mention because they are not in the channel.
post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.description: Ending of the notice shown after mentioning users who aren't in a channel with an access policy, where they can't be invited; preceded by the mentioned usernames.

post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.defaultMessage: did not get notified by this mention because they are not in the board.
post_body.check_for_out_of_channel_menti.description: Board version of the notice shown after mentioning users who aren't in a board with an access policy, where they can't be invited; preceded by the mentioned usernames.

post_body.commentedOn.description: Label above a reply post in the message list indicating which root message it replies to; {name} is the root post author's username; followed by an excerpt of that message, so keep the trailing space.

post_body.commentedOn.loadingMessage.description: Placeholder text shown while loading the root message that a reply refers to; ellipsis indicates loading.

post_body.deleted.description: Placeholder text shown in place of a message body after the message has been deleted; rendered in parentheses.

post_body.plusMore.defaultMessage: plus {count, number} other {count, plural, one {file} other {files}}
post_body.plusMore.description: Fragment appended after the first attached filename in a reply reference (e.g. 'file.png plus 2 other files'); {count} is the number of additional file attachments; keep the leading space.

post_body.team_access_control.added.defaultMessage: You have been added to {teamName} because you now meet the membership requirements.
post_body.team_access_control.added.description: System message telling the user they were automatically added to a team by an access-control policy; {teamName} is the team's name.

post_body.team_access_control.removed.defaultMessage: You have been removed from {teamName} because you no longer meet the membership requirements.
post_body.team_access_control.removed.description: System message telling the user they were automatically removed from a team by an access-control policy; {teamName} is the team's name.

post_card.channel_property.deleted_chann.description: Fallback shown in the flagged-message review card when the message's channel no longer exists; {channelId} is the raw channel ID.

post_card.channel_property.deleted_team.description: Fallback shown in the flagged-message review card when the message's team no longer exists; {teamId} is the raw team ID.

post_delete.notPosted.description: Title of the dialog shown when a comment fails because the message being replied to was deleted.

post_delete.okay.description: Dismiss button of the dialog explaining that the replied-to message was deleted.

post_delete.someone.defaultMessage: Someone deleted the message on which you tried to post a comment.
post_delete.someone.description: Body of the dialog shown when the message the user tried to comment on was deleted by someone else.

post_header.update_status.description: Inline button next to the current user's name on their own post, prompting them to set a custom status; shown when no status is set.

post_info.actions.noActions.first_line.description: First line of the empty-state popover for the message Actions menu; continues into a second line, so the sentence is split across two strings.

post_info.actions.noActions.second_line.description: Second line of the empty-state popover for the message Actions menu; completes the sentence started in the first line.

post_info.actions.tooltip.actions.description: Accessibility label for the message Actions menu button; lowercased when read; compact.

post_info.actions.tutorialTip.defaultMessage:
Message actions that are provided
through apps, integrations or plugins
have moved to this menu item.
post_info.actions.tutorialTip.description: Body of the onboarding tutorial tooltip pointing at the message Actions menu; \n sequences are line breaks.

post_info.actions.tutorialTip.title.description: Title of the tutorial tip pointing at the message Actions menu (actions provided by apps/integrations).

post_info.actions.visitMarketplace.description: Button in the empty message-Actions popover linking to the App Marketplace.

post_info.ai_generated.by_user.description: Tooltip on the AI-generated indicator of a message, identifying who posted it; {username} is that user's username preceded by @.

post_info.ai_generated.self.description: Small badge label on messages produced by an AI agent; compact space.

post_info.auto_responder.description: Tag displayed next to the sender's name on automatic out-of-office reply messages; rendered in a small badge, uppercase in English.

post_info.comment_icon.tooltip.reply.description: Tooltip and accessible label of the reply (speech bubble) icon on a message; opens the thread. 'Reply' is a verb.

post_info.copy.description: Menu item in the message actions menu that copies the message text to the clipboard.

post_info.del.description: Destructive menu item in the message actions menu that deletes the message; 'Delete' is a verb.

post_info.dot_menu.tooltip.more.description: Tooltip and accessible label of the '...' (dot menu) button on a message that opens more actions; also lowercased for the aria-label.

post_info.edit.description: Menu item in the message actions menu that starts editing the message; also used as a button in post edit history views. 'Edit' is a verb.

post_info.edit.aria_label.defaultMessage: Select to restore an old message.
post_info.edit.aria_label.description: Accessibility label for an entry in the message edit history panel; selecting the entry restores that older version of the message.

post_info.edit.current_version.description: Label on the newest entry in the message edit history panel.

post_info.edit.history.retrieveError.description: Heading of the error state when a message's edit history cannot be loaded.

post_info.edit.history.retrieveErrorVerb.defaultMessage: There was an error loading the history for this message. Check your network connection or try again later.
post_info.edit.history.retrieveErrorVerb.description: Subheading of the error state when a message's edit history fails to load.

post_info.edit.restore.description: Action label and modal title for restoring an older version of an edited message from its edit history; 'version' means a previous revision of the message.

post_info.edit.restore_question.description: Title in question form of the confirmation modal for restoring an older version of an edited message.

post_info.edit.undo.description: Undo button in the toast shown after restoring a previous version of a message; verb, compact.

post_info.info.view_additional_info.description: Tooltip/accessibility label of the info icon on a post that opens additional post details.

post_info.marketplace.description: Menu item in the message Actions menu that opens the App Marketplace.

post_info.menuAriaLabel.description: Screen-reader label for the '...' (more options) button on a message.

post_info.message.show_less.description: Toggle link at the bottom of a long message that collapses it back to the truncated view.

post_info.message.show_more.description: Toggle link at the bottom of a truncated long message that expands the full text.

post_info.message.visible.description: Marker appended to ephemeral posts indicating only the current user can see the message.

post_info.message.visible.compact.description: Suffix appended to an ephemeral (system-only) message in compact display mode; keep the leading space and parentheses because it is concatenated to the message text.

post_info.move_thread.description: Menu item in the message actions menu that moves a thread to another channel; 'Move' is a verb, 'Thread' a noun.

post_info.permalink.description: Menu item in the message actions menu that copies a permanent link to the message.

post_info.pin.description: Menu item in the message actions menu that pins the message to the channel's pinned posts list; 'Pin' is a verb.

post_info.post_reminder.menu.description: Submenu label in the message actions menu that opens reminder time options; 'Remind' is a verb (set a reminder about this message).

post_info.post_reminder.sub_menu.custom.description: Reminder submenu option opening a custom date/time picker.

post_info.post_reminder.sub_menu.header.description: Header (ends with a colon) above the reminder time options in the message reminder submenu.

post_info.post_reminder.sub_menu.one_hou.description: Reminder submenu option to be reminded about the message in one hour; compact menu item.

post_info.post_reminder.sub_menu.thirty_.description: Reminder submenu option to be reminded in 30 minutes; 'mins' is an abbreviation of minutes, compact menu item.

post_info.post_reminder.sub_menu.tomorro.description: Reminder submenu option to be reminded about the message tomorrow.

post_info.post_reminder.sub_menu.two_hou.description: Reminder submenu option to be reminded about the message in two hours; compact menu item.

post_info.quarantine.description: Menu item in the message actions menu (content moderation feature) that flags the message for review by moderators; 'Quarantine' is a verb.

post_info.reply.description: Menu item in the message actions menu that opens the thread to reply; 'Reply' is a verb.

post_info.show_translation.description: Menu item in the message actions menu that reveals the automatic translation of the message; 'Show' is a verb.

post_info.submenu.icon.description: Accessibility label for the right-arrow icon on a menu item that opens a submenu; displayed lowercased.

post_info.submenu.mobile.description: Accessibility label for the modal that displays a menu's submenu options on mobile.

post_info.system.description: Sender name displayed for messages generated by the system rather than a user.

post_info.tooltip.actions.description: Tooltip on the message Actions menu button; compact space.

post_info.tooltip.add_reactions.description: Tooltip/accessible label of the emoji icon in a message's hover toolbar that opens the emoji picker to add a reaction.

post_info.translation_icon.description: Tooltip/accessibility label of the icon indicating a message was automatically translated.

post_info.translation_icon_processing.description: Loading indicator text shown while a message is being auto-translated; ellipsis indicates progress.

post_info.translation_icon_unavailable.description: Tooltip on the translation icon when auto-translation for the message failed or is unavailable.

post_info.translation_icon.hint.description: Tooltip hint on the auto-translated message icon; clicking the icon shows the original untranslated text.

post_info.translation_icon.title.description: Tooltip title on the icon shown on messages that were automatically translated.

post_info.unpin.description: Menu item in the message actions menu that removes the message from the channel's pinned posts; 'Unpin' is a verb.

post_info.unread.description: Menu item in the message actions menu that marks the message (and later ones) as unread.

post_message_preview.channel.description: Footer under a forwarded/previewed message indicating its visibility; {channel} is the source channel's name prefixed with '~'.

post_message_view.edited.description: Small indicator label appended to a message that has been edited; compact space, also used as the button's accessible name.

post_message_view.view_post_edit_history.description: Hint line in the tooltip on the 'Edited' indicator telling the post author they can click to open the edit history.

post_pre_header.flagged.description: Small badge above a message indicating the current user saved it; clickable to open the Saved messages list; compact space.

post_pre_header.pinned.description: Small badge above a message indicating it is pinned to the channel; clickable to open the pinned messages list; compact space.

post_priority.acknowledgements.title.description: Heading of the popover listing the users who acknowledged a message.

post_priority.button.acknowledge.description: Button shown under a message that requested acknowledgement; clicking it confirms the user has read the message. Verb.

post_priority.error.no_mentions.description: Error in the message priority controls when persistent notifications are enabled but the message contains no @-mentions to notify.

post_priority.error.special_mentions.defaultMessage: {mention} can’t be used with persistent notifications
post_priority.error.special_mentions.description: Error in the message priority controls when a group mention is used with persistent notifications; {mention} is the disallowed mention (e.g. @channel).

post_priority.persistent_notifications.d.defaultMessage: Recipients will be notified every {interval, plural, one {1 minute} other {{interval} minutes}} until they acknowledge or reply
post_priority.persistent_notifications.d.description: Help text under the persistent notifications toggle in the message priority picker; ICU plural on {interval}, the number of minutes between repeated notifications.

post_priority.persistent_notifications.t.description: Label of the toggle in the message priority picker that repeatedly notifies recipients until they respond.
Tooltip on the bell icon in the priority label row above the message box, indicating persistent notifications are enabled for this message.

post_priority.picker.apply.description: Button label in the message priority picker that applies the chosen priority settings to the draft message.

post_priority.picker.cancel.description: Button label in the message priority picker that discards the priority changes.

post_priority.picker.header.description: Heading of the popup for choosing a message's priority before sending.

post_priority.priority.important.description: 'Important' priority level; used both as the label on the priority badge shown on messages and as an option in the message priority picker.

post_priority.priority.standard.description: Default (no special priority) option in the message priority picker.

post_priority.priority.urgent.description: 'Urgent' priority level; used both as the label on the priority badge shown on messages and as an option in the message priority picker.

post_priority.remove.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label for the '×' button that removes the priority label from a draft message; {priority} is the translated priority name (Important/Urgent).

post_priority.request_acknowledgement.description: Label next to the checkmark icon above the message box when acknowledgement will be requested from recipients.

post_priority.request_acknowledgement.to.description: Tooltip in the message priority controls indicating the message will request an acknowledgement from recipients.

post_priority.requested_ack.description.defaultMessage: An acknowledgement button will appear with your message
post_priority.requested_ack.description.description: Help text under the request-acknowledgement toggle in the message priority picker, explaining recipients get a button to confirm they read the message.

post_priority.requested_ack.text.description: Label of the toggle in the message priority picker that asks recipients to acknowledge the message.

post_priority.you.acknowledge.description: Suffix appended after the current user's name in the acknowledgements list to mark it as themselves.

post_reminder_custom_time_picker_modal.d.description: Fallback title for the message reminder dialog (same wording as the header).

post_reminder.custom_time_picker_modal.h.description: Title of the dialog for choosing a custom date and time for a message reminder.

post_reminder.custom_time_picker_modal.s.description: Confirm button label in the custom message-reminder dialog that schedules the reminder.

post.ariaLabel.attachment.description: Screen reader suffix appended to a post's accessible label when the post has one file attachment; the leading comma matters because it is concatenated.

post.ariaLabel.attachmentMultiple.description: Fragment appended to a message's screen-reader label describing multiple attachments; keep the leading comma because it is concatenated; {attachmentCount} is a number.

post.ariaLabel.message.description: Screen reader label for a post; {time} and {date} are when it was posted, {authorName} the author, {message} the post text.

post.ariaLabel.messageIsFlagged.description: Fragment appended to a message's screen-reader label when the message is saved (bookmarked); keep the leading comma; concatenated with the rest of the label.

post.ariaLabel.messageIsFlaggedAndPinned.description: Fragment appended to a message's screen-reader label when the message is both saved and pinned; keep the leading comma.

post.ariaLabel.messageIsPinned.description: Fragment appended to a message's screen-reader label when the message is pinned to the channel; keep the leading comma.

post.ariaLabel.reaction.description: Screen reader suffix appended to a post's accessible label when the post has one emoji reaction; the leading comma matters because it is concatenated.

post.ariaLabel.reactionMultiple.description: Fragment appended to a message's screen-reader label describing multiple emoji reactions; keep the leading comma; {reactionCount} is a number.

post.ariaLabel.replyMessage.description: Screen reader label for a reply post in a thread; {time}/{date} are when it was posted, {authorName} the author, {message} the reply text.

post.ariaLabel.translated.description: Screen reader suffix appended to a post's label when it was automatically translated; {sourceLanguage} and {targetLanguage} are language names; leading comma matters for concatenation.

post.burn_on_read.confirmation_modal.bod.defaultMessage: This message will be permanently deleted for you right away and can't be undone.
post.burn_on_read.confirmation_modal.bod.description: Body of the confirmation modal shown to a message recipient before immediately deleting a burn-on-read message for themselves.

post.burn_on_read.confirmation_modal.bod.defaultMessage: This message will be permanently deleted for all recipients right away. This action can't be undone. Are you sure you want to delete this message?
post.burn_on_read.confirmation_modal.bod.description: Body of the confirmation modal shown to the sender before immediately deleting a burn-on-read message for all recipients.

post.burn_on_read.confirmation_modal.can.description: Cancel button of the burn-on-read delete-now confirmation modal.

post.burn_on_read.confirmation_modal.che.description: Checkbox label in the burn-on-read delete confirmation modal; suppresses this confirmation in the future.

post.burn_on_read.confirmation_modal.con.description: Destructive confirm button of the burn-on-read delete confirmation modal; deletes the message immediately.

post.burn_on_read.confirmation_modal.del.description: Confirm button label of the burn-on-read delete confirmation modal while the deletion request is in progress.

post.burn_on_read.confirmation_modal.tit.description: Title of the confirmation modal asking whether to immediately delete a burn-on-read message.

post.burn_on_read.reveal_error.defaultMessage: Unable to reveal message. Please try again later.
post.burn_on_read.reveal_error.description: Error message shown when clicking to reveal a burn-on-read (self-destructing) message fails.

post.burn_on_read.reveal_error.forbidden.defaultMessage: You don't have permission to view this message.
post.burn_on_read.reveal_error.forbidden.description: Error shown when revealing a burn-on-read (self-destructing) message fails with a permission (403) error.

post.burn_on_read.reveal_error.generic.defaultMessage: Failed to reveal message. Please try again.
post.burn_on_read.reveal_error.generic.description: Generic error shown when revealing a burn-on-read (self-destructing) message fails.

post.burn_on_read.reveal_error.not_found.defaultMessage: This message is no longer available.
post.burn_on_read.reveal_error.not_found.description: Error shown when a burn-on-read message can no longer be revealed because it no longer exists.

post.burn_on_read.timer.aria_label.defaultMessage: Burn-on-read timer: {time}. Click to delete now.
post.burn_on_read.timer.aria_label.description: Accessibility label for the countdown chip on a revealed burn-on-read message; {time} is the remaining time before deletion.

post.burn_on_read.timer.tooltip.line1.description: First tooltip line on the burn-on-read countdown chip; {time} is the remaining time until the message self-deletes.

post.burn_on_read.timer.tooltip.line2.description: Second tooltip line on the burn-on-read countdown chip, telling the user clicking deletes the message right away.

post.burn_on_read.view_message.description: Button label on the concealed placeholder of a burn-on-read message; clicking reveals the message and starts its deletion timer.

post.error.access.defaultMessage: The post you're requesting is private or does not exist.
post.error.access.description: Body text of the error page shown when a linked post is private or does not exist; 'post' is a noun (a message).

post.error.title.description: Title of the error page shown when a linked post is private or does not exist; 'Post' is a noun (a message).

post.message_attachment.action_failed.description: Error shown when the action behind an interactive message-attachment button (from an integration) fails to run.

post.redacted_files.subtitle.defaultMessage: Access to files is restricted based on attributes
post.redacted_files.subtitle.description: Explanatory subtitle of the placeholder shown instead of file attachments the user is not permitted to see under attribute-based access control.

post.redacted_files.title.description: Title of the placeholder shown instead of file attachments the user is not permitted to see.

post.reminder.acknowledgement.defaultMessage: You will be reminded at {reminderTime}, {reminderDate} about this message from {username}: {permaLink}
post.reminder.acknowledgement.description: Ephemeral confirmation message after setting a reminder on a message; {reminderTime} and {reminderDate} are the scheduled time and date, {username} is the message author, {permaLink} is a link to the message.

post.reminder.systemBot.defaultMessage: Hi there, here's your reminder about this message from {username}: {permaLink}
post.reminder.systemBot.description: Direct message sent by the system bot when a message reminder fires; {username} is the original message author and {permaLink} is a link to the message.

post.renderError.message.defaultMessage: An error occurred while rendering this post.
post.renderError.message.description: Error text shown in place of a message when rendering the post crashed (error boundary).

post.renderError.retry.description: Button label under the post rendering error that attempts to render the message again.

post.renderError.retryLabel.description: Accessibility label for the retry button shown in place of a message that failed to render; 'post' is a noun (a message).

postlist.toast.history.description: Text of the toast shown at the top of the message list when the user is scrolled back viewing older messages.

postlist.toast.newMessages.description: Text of the toast announcing new messages in the channel; {count} is the number of new messages.

postlist.toast.newMessagesSince.defaultMessage: {count, number} new {count, plural, one {message} other {messages}} {isToday, select, true {} other {since}} {date}
postlist.toast.newMessagesSince.description: Unread messages toast at the top of the channel; {count} is the number of new messages with plural, {isToday} selects whether to include the word 'since', {date} is a formatted date or time.

postlist.toast.scrollToBottom.description: Floating toast/button over the message list that scrolls to the newest messages; 'recents' means the most recent messages; compact space.

postlist.toast.scrollToLatest.description: Toast button at the top of the message list; clicking it scrolls down to the newest unread messages.

postlist.toast.scrollToUnread.description: Action link on a toast; clicking it scrolls the message list up to the first unread message.

postlist.toast.searchHint.defaultMessage: Tip: Try {searchShortcut} to search this channel
postlist.toast.searchHint.description: Hint toast in the message list suggesting the search feature; {searchShortcut} renders keyboard shortcut keys.

posts_view.loadMore.description: Button row at the top of the message list that loads older messages when clicked.

posts_view.newMsg.description: Label on the horizontal separator line in the message list marking where unread messages begin.

pricing_modal.btn.tooltip.description: Tooltip on the 'View plans' button in the global header clarifying that the button is shown only to system admins.

pricing_modal.btn.viewPlans.description: Button in the global header that opens the pricing/plans modal; visible to system admins.

pricing_modal.wantToTry.description: Lead-in text before the 'notify your admin' button in upsell prompts, shown to non-admin users before a trial has been used; ends with a space because the button text follows inline.

pricing_modal.wantToUpgrade.description: Lead-in text before the 'notify your admin' button in upsell prompts, shown to non-admin users on a workspace that could upgrade its plan; ends with a space because the button text follows inline.

product_menu_item.open_in_new_tab.description: Tooltip/accessibility label on external product links in the product switcher menu indicating they open in a new browser tab.

product_rail.ariaLabel.description: Accessible name for the vertical navigation rail beside the team sidebar that switches between Channels, Threads and products such as Playbooks and Boards.

product_rail.boards.description: Label under the Boards icon in the product navigation rail. Clicking it shows only boards in the left sidebar.

product_rail.channels.description: Label under the Channels icon in the product navigation rail. Clicking it shows only channels and direct messages in the left sidebar, leaving out boards.

product_rail.teamMenu.buttonLabel.description: Accessible name of the current team button at the top of the product navigation rail, shown while the team sidebar is hidden. It opens a menu of the user's teams.

workspace_limits.post_history_banner.cta.description: Button in the message-history limit banner on Cloud free plans; leads to upgrading to restore access to older messages.

wysiwyg.link.display_text.description: Placeholder of the input for the link's visible text in the link editing popover of the rich text editor.

wysiwyg.link.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the URL input in the link editing popover of the rich text editor.

wysiwyg.link.remove.description: Title/tooltip of the icon button in the link editing popover that deletes the link from the text.

wysiwyg.link.save_hint.description: Compact hint in the link editing popover telling the user to press Enter to save; the ↵ symbol precedes 'ENTER'.

yourcomputer.description: Menu item in the upload source menu for choosing files from the local device, as opposed to plugin-provided sources.

youtube_video.play_button.aria_label.description: Accessibility label for the play button overlay on an embedded YouTube video preview.

youtube_video.thumbnail.alt_text.description: Alt text for the thumbnail image of an embedded YouTube video; {videoTitle} is the video's title.
